en.quote: And it shall come to pass, that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, saith the LORD, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.
en.riddle: with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וְהָיָה הַגּוֹי וְהַמַּמְלָכָה אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא־יַעַבְדוּ אֹתוֹ אֶת־נְבוּכַדְנֶאצַּר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר לֹֽא־יִתֵּן אֶת־צַוָּארוֹ בְּעֹל מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל בַּחֶרֶב וּבָרָעָב וּבַדֶּבֶר אֶפְקֹד עַל־הַגּוֹי הַהוּא נְאֻם־יְהוָה עַד־תֻּמִּי אֹתָם בְּיָדֽוֹ
he.speaker: ־יְהוָה
